Description.SourceString:
Why is Umbral Sands yellow? Because the desert weed!

Desert weed is an admirable plant, mainly for its ability to survive no matter the conditions. Even when there are no nutrients in the sand, water is scarce, and the temperature only exists at the extremes, the desert weed is the little plant that could. It finds potential in the tiny cracks between death and more death. We are all playing this little survival game, but perhaps the desert weed is out-performing us all.
